blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—Mayor Benjamin Magalong has urged education leaders to promote the ethical and responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) in schools, emphasizing that the technology should support learning rather than make students dependent on it. In a statement Sunday, Nov. 8, Magalong stressed the need for proper and controlled use of AI in education during the 2026 Regional Assembly of Education Leaders (RAEL) of the Department of Education (DepEd) Mimaropa Region, which was held recently in this city. Speaking before school principals, school heads and other education personnel, Magalong highlighted the role of teachers in keeping students curious and developing their […]...
